name: fprintf
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, 'x'); fclose(fid); s = fileread(fname); delete(fname); r1 = double(strlength(s));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip via tempname). fprintf writes 'x' to file -- read back length 1. NOTE: numkit fprintf returns void (no byte count); MATLAB returns the count. Probe uses round-trip rather than return value.
